title: Release Notes
description: See what has changed right here in the About window. A green dot on the info button lets you know when there is something new.

title: Quick Links menu
description: A new Quick Links menu in the top bar lets you copy or open the current page, record, archive path or API query in one click.

title: Right-click menus and new tabs
description: Right-click any result card or Archive Explorer row to copy links or add it to your cart. Middle-click or Ctrl-click opens a record in a new tab.

title: Preview more file types
description: Tables, text, PDFs, video and audio products can be previewed directly on the record page, with file-type thumbnails in search and the cart.

title: Archive Explorer icons and playback
description: Archive Explorer shows an icon for each file type, and audio and video files play right in the Preview panel.

title: Open in Archive Explorer
description: Jump from a search result, record or cart item straight to its location in the Archive Explorer.

title: Adding bundles from Preview
description: The Archive Explorer Preview panel's Add to cart button now works for whole bundles and volumes.

title: Start Time and Flight Day filters
description: Start Time is now a default filter and accepts a date and time (UTC). A Flight Day filter is also available by default.

title: Faster back-and-forth searching
description: Returning to a search you already ran is instant, and your Grid, List, Table or Map view is kept when you come back from a record.

title: Search error fixes
description: Sorting by File Name and running Advanced Filters queries no longer show a Search Error.

title: Most novel images first
description: Search results are sorted by machine-learning novelty by default so unusual images surface first. Sort options also have friendlier names.

title: SCALPSS (Blue Ghost Mission 1)
description: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 1 SCALPSS products have readable names and filename breakdowns.

title: Redesigned record pages
description: Record pages have a new Overview with an at-a-glance summary, a timeline, file cards and links to instrument documentation.

title: Filename breakdowns
description: Record pages explain each part of a product's filename for MSL, MER, InSight, Phoenix, Pathfinder, MRO, MESSENGER, MGS MOC, Cassini ISS, Odyssey THEMIS, Clementine, M3, JunoCam, LCROSS, Galileo SSI, LRO LAMP and Lunar Orbiter.

title: Simpler search layout
description: The left icon rail is gone: filters live in a sidebar, the map is a results view you can split alongside the others, and phones get a bottom navigation bar.

title: Snappier Archive Explorer
description: The Archive Explorer stays responsive for missions with thousands of volumes, and short result lists no longer leave a spinner running.

title: Cancelling downloads
description: Cancelling a download now stops it immediately.

title: Machine-learning filters
description: Filter by machine-learning classification and confidence, and pick filters by friendly name in the Add Filter window.

title: Add whole bundles to your cart
description: Add an entire bundle or volume to your cart from the Archive Explorer in one click.

title: Deprecated folders in Archive Explorer
description: Archive Explorer now shows deprecated folders so you can browse their contents too.

title: Easier download choices
description: Choosing a download type is clearer, ZIP downloads work in Firefox and download scripts match your operating system.

title: Atlas is out of beta
description: Beta labels have been removed from the interface.

title: Bulk download size warning
description: Atlas warns you before starting a very large download.

title: Table view and page title fixes
description: List and Table views show the right columns, headers line up, and browser tab titles follow the page you are on.
